notes: The central u-tokyo.ac.jp/en pages and the Science and Humanities-related graduate-school sites disallow crawling in robots.txt, so the master's list was built from graduate-school sites that allow it. Most scores, eligibility rules and department requirements sit in PDF application guidelines, which the snapshot tool stores as raw bytes without extracted text, so nothing could be quoted from them; those are listed in remaining_urls. Mathematical Sciences and Medicine pages were read but state no quotable requirement with a full date.
